feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The candidate is iteration 4's controller (kp 1.4, kd 0.5, base_speed 1.0, line_loss 'last_direction', weights [-2,-1,0,1,2]) with all five sensors moved from y 0.05 to y 0.07. The x positions and 16 mm footprints are unchanged. Iteration 4 (kd 0.5) scored 624.6, essentially tied with the iteration 2 best of 625.2. Its oval finished 20/20 at 1.96 s, and it lowered s-bend steering_oscillation slightly (0.42 to 0.38) but dropped s-bend finishes from 17 to 15 of 20. The slalom was still off_track in all 20 runs at progress 0.31 and max_error at the 0.0666 m mean. The off-track limit is max(0.06, 0.0125 + body_width/4), so widening the body cannot help, which leaves sensor lead as the untested lever. The change is geometry only, so any shift in results can be attributed to the sensors. The main risk is that more forward lead adds turn gain, which could raise s-bend and oval oscillation (iteration 4 measured 0.38 on the s-bend and 0.21 on the oval). Approve: the candidate is valid, it is a single-variable step from the tied best design, and a race is the fastest way to test whether lead is the limit on the slalom. Read the race as follows. If slalom progress rises above 0.31, max_error falls below 0.06 and the oval still finishes 20/20, lead was the limit; the next step is y 0.075. If slalom progress stays near 0.3 with low oscillation, the limit is speed through the sharp slalom turns; the next step is base_speed 0.9, provided the s-bend completion time stays under 3 s (it was about 2.3 to 2.6 s). If s-bend finishes fall below 15 of 20 or oscillation exceeds about 0.5, return the sensors to y 0.05 and keep kd 0.5.
requested_changes: Keep kp 1.4, kd 0.5, base_speed 1.0 and the x positions unchanged, and test the sensors at y 0.07. Iteration 4 showed slalom progress of 0.31 with max_error at the 0.0666 m limit, so more lead is the next untested lever.

If slalom progress rises and max_error falls below 0.06 with the oval still finishing 20/20, try y 0.075 next. If slalom progress stays near 0.3 with low oscillation, lower base_speed to about 0.9, but only if the s-bend completion_time stays under 3 s.
If s-bend finishes fall below 15 of 20 or steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.5, return the sensors to y 0.05 and keep kd 0.5, because the extra lead has added too much turn gain.
